name: Daiichi Jitsugyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Daiichi Jitsugyo Co., Ltd. engages in the import, export, and sale of plant and machinery equipment in Japan, China, India, rest of Asia, the United States, rest of the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Plant & Energy, Energy Solutions, Industrial Machinery, Electronics, Automotive, Healthcare, and Aviation & Social Infrastructure segments.
